create_roc_auc_binary: compute the ROC AUC score for binary classification with ground truth labels and prediction scores
create_roc_auc_multiclass: compute the ROC AUC score for multiclass classification using one-vs-rest or one-vs-one strategy
create_roc_auc_multilabel: compute the ROC AUC score for multilabel classification with per-class or averaged results
test_ROCAUC_compute: test the ROCAUC compute method with references and prediction_scores inputs
review_ROCAUC_info: review the ROCAUC _info method that returns metric metadata and input feature schema
